name: 72223 · Little Rock, AR
findings: ZIP 72223 (Little Rock) has 145 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72223 (Little Rock) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72223 (Little Rock) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 56 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
